protocol.question: Does a bond-aware reference and/or aligned four-body IQP phase bank improve shared fitting and learned cross-layer dependence on already-inspected development conditions?
protocol.status: development ablation, no fresh generalization claim

encoders.bond: per-layer physical amplitudes exp[(c/2+i*pi/8)*sumspinbond]/sqrt Z(c); product across layers; no kappa encoded

circuits.base: complete two-local bank deduplicated by characters on even/even Fourier support:30 independent generators
circuits.four_body: base plus deduplicated aligned bond-pair XXXX strings:32 independent generators

protocol.data: 1000 train and1000 independent validation samples per condition and seed; same archives across4models; all11conditions used in fitting and selection
protocol.initialization: data_initialize pooled11000samples on original36generators; sum parameters with identical restrictedcharacters to preserve initialphase; extended2parameters initializedzero; paired acrossencoders
protocol.selection: initial,scheduledfinal,lowest validationMMD candidate; choose minimum mean empirical validationTVD over11developmentconditions
protocol.stage1: exact population MMD, existing3expected-bodyness bandwidths, all4models all3seeds
protocol.stage2_gate: Any bond variant passes if across3seeds median meanTVD<=.15, worst conditionTVD acrossseeds<=.25, median meanencoder-only improvement>=.03, worst connected-bondRMSE<=.10. Gate is a provisional development decision, not a theorem or significance test.
protocol.stage2: If a bond variant passes, run sampled-MMD training at all3seeds for the passing bond variants plus cat with corresponding circuit; same steps,data,initialization,selection. Fixed512nonidentity masks perbandwidth percondition,2048fresh reference samples percondition perupdate, unbiased target and model second-moment U-statistics; fixed2048reference validation samples, independent from training; one shared reference draw set across masks/bandwidths percondition is allowed and unbiased. At n8 cache amplitude/character queries for operators and reference strings; reference draws must use validated transfer sampler for bond, never an enumerated probability categorical sampler.
protocol.checks: reference amplitudes/prefixes/sampling/ratios and moments against exact small-system values; restrictedphase rank and collapsed initial equivalence; inputdistinguishability bound; targetenergies; exactMMD against double kernel expectation; sampledgradient check beforestage2
protocol.stopping: If no bond variant passes, stop after stage1 and record failure without retuning maps,phase,steps or gates. Classical superiority neverrequired. Fresh generalization protocol remains separate.

outcome: Bond+four-body improves exact development fitting to meanTVD .09698 from cat-base .12473. Correlation errors remain uneven; both bond variants miss worst-correlation threshold, so no sampled training. Reference sampler and moment/gradient queries passed finite numerical checks. No new generalization claim and no classical-superiority criterion.
artifact_scope: Disposable development ablation; no production or manuscript changes. Temporary scripts/data/checkpoints removed after capture.
